description: Reputation (0.20.0): what each place, each species and each system's authorities think of you, and how word of it travels. See docs/runtime/reputation.md. Code: scripts/reputation.gd.

tier_notes.Barred: Traffic control won't clear you, nobody here will give you work, and everything costs more. The tug still comes if you're stranded, with a lecture and a bill.
tier_notes.Unwelcome: Freight off the board and nothing else: nobody asks you in person, and crew won't sign on. Steep fees.
tier_notes.Doubtful: Fewer jobs, lower pay and higher fees. People are watching.
tier_notes.Unknown: Nobody has an opinion yet. Enjoy it.
tier_notes.Known: Sealed crates are offered, and pay is a little better.
tier_notes.Trusted: Priority berths (traffic control won't make you hold), lower fees, better pay.
tier_notes.Respected: Private contracts, the best rates and the lowest fees.

deeds._doc: Where a deed's points go. place: the site you're at. species: the people there (or the ones you helped), at species_share. authority: the system's traffic control and port authority, in full, and other systems' at authority_share_elsewhere once word reaches them.
